reviews.title: Sturdy and beautiful!
reviews.comment: Beautiful desk and not hard to assemble. It looks great and its sturdy.
reviews.author: Latasha Golden

reviews.title: Great Design!
reviews.comment: I bought this desk for when I need to work from home and I only had extra space in our guest room.  This is the perfect size.  The love the simple design and how you can pick the different color desk and legs.  It was extremely easy to put together.  The electric standing option is awesome!  It is so smooth moving up and down.  Also, the desk is small but mighty. Very sturdy.  I highly recommend this!
reviews.author: Ashley

reviews.title: Quality Desk
reviews.comment: I bought this desk for my wife who works from home full-time and she absolutely LOVES it. The color options are great and the desk itself is very sturdy and built well.
reviews.author: Michael Bergamo

reviews.title: Love it
reviews.comment: This desk is just the right size for my needs and so far everything works smoothly. It's very sturdy wipes down easily to clean with a damp cloth and the motor is super quiet! Great value for the money. A++
reviews.author: Syameeze

reviews.title: Stylish, sturdy and right size for me
reviews.comment: So happy that I could find this sturdy, easy-to-use stand-up desk in a more compact size. Looks and works great!
reviews.author: J. Alcala
